acquisition.bodyInterpretation: Nine saved HTML responses include an invalid-mobile-column response and a catalogue captcha; those are not date evidence. Two original PDFs were fully extracted offline and relevant pages visually inspected. WHUT had one native TLS timeout and one web timeout; XJAU had one invalid-mobile-page recovery endingHTTP410.

rules: Source-only date candidates; no canonical dates, statuses, publication, verifiedAt or reviewAfter changed.
The dispatch selects shared awards once; base IDs are taken exactly from root dispatch, not reselected from multi-school mappings.
Only exact2026 applicant routes support seven past-window observations. Unknown and blocked never prove open/closed availability.
XTU April30 is self-funded degree admission; its separate TypeB award has its own March1 applicant cutoff.
XTU current standing degree directory supports major identity only; unavailable2026 catalogue and Artificial Intelligent spelling are explicit limitations, with no programme fact renewal.
XISU Dec20/Jun20 and XAUT annual March-May remain unanchored. XJAU2026 catalogue alone establishes no date.
Failed source paths end after one reasonable fallback. Captcha and HTTP200 do not establish a deadline.
PDF originals were fetched once; extraction and rendering were offline. No successor-year rollover or programme discontinuation is inferred.
